headline: Cloudflare launches granular AI bot controls; Case study warns firewall bot defense can strip SEO metadata

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Cloudflare introduces granular AI traffic controls, moving beyond one-size-fits-all blocking | Cloudflare 推出细粒度 AI 流量控制功能
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 传统的 robots.txt 或一刀切式阻断（Block All AI）会误伤有益的 AI 搜索引用流量（如 Perplexity/SearchGPT）。Cloudflare 的新功能允许站点在“允许 AI 搜索/引用”与“阻止 AI 模型训练/抓取”之间进行精细化平衡，这是 GEO 时代基础设施层的重要升级。
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Cloudflare has rolled out granular controls for AI bots, allowing site owners to distinguish between different types of AI traffic (such as search/citations vs. training scrapers) rather than relying on a binary block. This is managed directly within the Cloudflare dashboard under security/bot settings.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 登录 Cloudflare 后台，评估并调整 AI 爬虫策略，建议放行 AI 搜索/引用类 Bot（如 SearchGPT、Perplexity），同时阻断纯训练类 Bot。

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Aggressive firewall bot mitigation can strip critical SEO metadata and block search crawlers | 激进的防火墙防爬虫策略可能导致 SEO 元数据被剥离
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: 在应对恶意 Bot 攻击时，运维团队常通过 CDN/防火墙（如 Cloudflare、AWS WAF）实施紧急限制。这可能导致服务器在过载时向爬虫返回剥离了 title、canonical、hreflang 和 schema 的简化版 HTML，或者直接误杀 Googlebot，导致索引量和排名暴跌。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: A case study of a large online marketplace revealed a severe SEO drop caused by firewall-level bot restrictions that stripped title tags, hreflang, canonicals, and schema across core page types during a bot attack. After upgrading servers, implementing robots.txt crawl delays for non-essential bots, and whitelisting search crawlers, indexation recovered from 250k to 600k pages.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 检查 CDN/WAF 的速率限制和 Bot 管理规则，确保在触发防御机制时不会向 Googlebot 返回受损的 HTML，并使用工具模拟不同 IP/User-Agent 进行验证。
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 使用外部测试工具（如 SERP Lens 或自定义脚本）模拟 Googlebot，从不同区域的 IP 访问网站，特别是在高负载或触发防火墙规则时，检查返回的 HTML 中 title、canonical、hreflang 和 schema 是否完整，以及是否返回了 503 或 403 状态码。
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: 确保 Googlebot 在任何负载/防御状态下均能 100% 获取完整的 SEO 元数据和 200 OK 状态码，避免索引量异常波动。
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 低成本。主要风险是运维团队在配置防火墙时未将 Googlebot/Bingbot 列入白名单，或在边缘计算（Edge Functions）中错误地剥离了元数据。

sources.name: brodieseo
sources.excerpt: This was an SEO disaster... while it may look like the result of a core update or even a spam update, it wasn't. It was a result of bots heavily impacting the servers of an online marketplace (this is just one of many domains), and the team needed to put in place bot access restrictions at the firewall level that destroyed SEO just to keep the site up. To make matters worse, important attributes such as title tags, hreflang, canonicals, schema and more were removed or altered across core page types while the teams were scrambling to resolve the issues... not ideal at all. Now that their servers have been upgraded, we've put in place crawl delay mechanisms in robots.txt for all bots, blocked…
sources.author: @brodieseo

Today's Action Items.what_to_do: 登录 Cloudflare 后台配置精细化 AI 爬虫策略，平衡 AI 搜索流量与训练数据保护。
审计 CDN/WAF 防火墙规则，确保在高负载防爬虫机制触发时，Googlebot 不会被误杀或返回缺失元数据的 HTML。
